MIDI Drum Sequencer

Repository: https://github.com/thomasf/neotrellis-seq

Standalone 6-voice polyphonic USB-MIDI step sequencer for the Adafruit NeoTrellis M4 (SAMD51 Cortex-M4 at 120 MHz, 8×4 RGB elastomeric keypad). Features polymetric track lengths (up to 64 steps across 4 pages), 4-level velocity dynamics, generative algorithmic transforms, and 256-step undo/redo.

GitHub Repository Download Firmware (UF2) Issues & Discussions

Specifications & Architecture

FeatureDescription
Repositoryhttps://github.com/thomasf/neotrellis-seq
Firmwareneotrellis-seq.uf2 — prebuilt UF2 image (SAMD51 drag-and-drop flash)
Voices6 independent drum channels (Voice 0–5), mapped by default to General MIDI / Ableton Drum Rack (C1–D#2) on Channel 1.
Pattern Memory16 pattern slots per voice (96 total), switchable on the fly without interrupting playback.
Track LengthIndependent length per voice (1–64 steps across up to 4 switchable 16-step pages) for evolving polymeters and extended phrases.
Velocities4 expressive levels: Accent (127), Normal (99), Ghost / Muted (50), and Rest / Silence (0).
Undo / Redo256 edits deep across all voices. Swaps and all-voice transforms undo/redo in a single press.
TransformsAlgorithmic generators: Game of Life, Shift, Echo, Invert, Humanize, Drift, Declutter, Fill Empty.
MIDI TransportClass-compliant USB-MIDI following host clock (24 PPQN), start, stop, continue, and SPP.

Presses

PadActionDescription
STEP nToggle StepToggles the note on step n of the selected pattern (on active page, up to 64 steps).
VOICE vSelect VoiceSelects voice v for editing, flashes active page number in red on step grid, and lights up while it fires.
← PAGEPrevious PageSwitches the 16-step grid view to the previous page (Page 1–4). Lights up (COLOR_PMOD) when a previous page exists. Briefly flashes the active page number on the step grid in red.
PAGE →Next PageSwitches the 16-step grid view to the next page. Lights up (COLOR_PMOD) when the pattern extends into a subsequent page (up to 64 steps). Briefly flashes the active page number on the step grid in red.
CLEARClear PatternZeroes every step of the selected pattern across all pages.
MENUMenu ModeEnters settings menu (Voice Protect, playback path modifiers, MIDI note assignment). Press MENU again to return to sequencer.

Held modifiers

CombinationActionDescription
← PAGE + PAGE →Page Length ModeHolding both page buttons enters page length set mode. Both buttons light white (COLOR_PPOS), and steps 1–4 illuminate in red up to current page count. Tap STEP 1, 2, 3, or 4 to set pattern length to 16, 32, 48, or 64 steps.
← PAGE + PAGE → + ALLSet All Page LengthsHolding both page buttons with ALL, then tapping STEP 1–4 sets pattern length to 16, 32, 48, or 64 steps across all unprotected voices simultaneously.
ACCENT + STEP nAccent StepAccents step n (velocity 127) on the active page. Toggles an accented step back to normal velocity (99); switches a silent step on accented.
ACCENT + CLEARClear AccentsRemoves all accents from the selected pattern across all pages, leaving notes in place.
POS + STEP nSet PositionMoves the selected voice’s playhead to step n on the active page.
POS + ALL + STEP nSet All PositionMoves every voice’s playhead to step n on the active page simultaneously.
POS + FN1Rewind TransportResets playback position of all voices to step 0 and arms them to fire on next step/clock (can also be pressed as FN1 + POS).
VOICE v + STEP nSelect PatternSelects pattern slot n for voice v without modifying step data. Multiple voice pads can be held at once. Flashes active page in red.
ALL + STEP nSelect All PatternsSelects pattern slot n for all unprotected voices simultaneously (protected voices remain on their current slot). Flashes active page in red.
FN1 + …FN1Accesses secondary functions: pattern transforms, presets, voice swap, and rewind (see below).
FN1 + ALL + …FN1+ALLApplies functions across all unprotected voices simultaneously: all-voice transforms, kit presets, odd meters, and dropout (see below).
FN2 + COPYCopy PatternCopies the selected pattern to the paste buffer (pad 4).
FN2 + PASTEPaste PatternOverwrites the selected pattern with the paste buffer (pad 5).
FN2 + CLEARUndoSteps back through pattern edits (256 deep). Restores to original voice and slot (pad 12).
FN2 + REDORedoRedoes the last undone edit (pad 13).
FN2 + POS + STEP nSet LengthSets the selected pattern’s loop length to step n on the active page (current page × 16 + n, up to 64 steps).
FN2 + …FN2Accesses secondary function mode 2: copy, paste, undo, redo, loop length (see below).
FN2 + ALL + …FN2+ALLApplies secondary functions across all voices (see below).
FN1 + FN2 + PASTEPaste All SlotsOverwrites all 16 pattern slots of the selected voice with the paste buffer (pad 5; see below).

PadActionDescription
STEP 1, 2Shift ±1Shifts pattern left (STEP 1) or right (STEP 2) by 1 step, wrapping within length.
STEP 3, 4Shift ±4Shifts pattern left (STEP 3) or right (STEP 4) by 4 steps, wrapping within length.
STEP 5ReverseReverses the pattern within its active length.
STEP 6InvertInverts sounding and silent steps, keeping active pattern length.
STEP 7HumanizeRandomly varies sounding step velocities between ghost, normal, and accent, adding natural groove dynamics.
STEP 8Fill EmptyAdds notes on steps where no other voice sounds, prioritizing least crowded steps.
STEP 9ShuffleRandomly shuffles step order within the active pattern length.
STEP 10EchoCopies each note 2 steps later at half velocity. Repeated presses add successive echoes.
STEP 11DriftMoves one note 1 step left or right onto a free step, preserving velocity.
ACCENT + STEP nLoad PresetLoads pattern preset n (1–16), incorporating accents, normal hits, and ghost notes.
POSRewindResets playback position of all voices to step 0 and arms them to fire on next step/clock.
VOICE vSwap PatternSwaps selected pattern with voice v’s current pattern.

FN1+ALL

The pad map while FN1 and ALL are both held. Applies transforms across all six voices simultaneously. Voices with Voice Protect enabled are shielded from all-voice transforms and retain their existing patterns and lengths. Evaluates voices in order, enabling generative interlocking variations across all drum tracks.

FN2

The pad map while holding FN2. Tapping COPY (pad 4) copies the active pattern; tapping PASTE (pad 5) pastes it. Below them, UNDO (pad 12) steps backwards through edits and REDO (pad 13) redoes them. Holding FN2 and the button above it (POS, pad 21) while tapping any step (1–16) sets the active pattern's loop length on the active page (page × 16 + n, up to 64 steps). With ALL held, sets loop lengths across all unprotected voices.

Menu Mode: Voice Protect & Playback Paths

Press MENU to enter settings. Voice pads 0–5 select the settings page for that voice (the active voice lights in white). The top-left button (STEP 1) toggles Voice Protect on and off. The second step row (STEP 5–8) toggles 4 independent, combinable Playback Path Modifiers. All toggles illuminate green (COLOR_GREEN) when active and red (COLOR_RED) when inactive. Hold any voice pad (VOICE 0–5) to reassign its MIDI note on the 16-step grid.

PadActionDescription
VOICE 0–5 (tap)Select Voice PageSelects which voice’s settings page is displayed. Active voice button lights in white. Voice buttons continue to flash in sync with playback (inverted: turning off briefly instead of turning white when a note plays).
Hold VOICE 0–5Voice MenuHold a voice pad (or tap a step while holding) to enter the Voice Menu and reassign its MIDI note on the 4×4 drum rack grid. Release to return.
STEP 1 (Row 1)Toggle Voice ProtectProtects the voice from all global actions (ALL and FN1 + ALL transforms, kits, and length changes). Its pattern stays untouched unless edited directly.
STEP 5 (Row 2)Ping-Pong PathForward-then-reverse bounce without repeating ends (e.g. 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 2 → 1). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 6 (Row 2)Spiral PathOutside-in clockwise grid traversal (0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 11, 15, 14, 13, 12, 8, 4, 5, 6, 10, 9). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 7 (Row 2)Phase Slip PathRotational phase slip (+1 step offset each completed cycle, staggered by +2 steps per voice). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 8 (Row 2)Mutate PathRandomly switches between all unused path modifiers every 4 bars (Stutter, Weave, Drunken, Beat Ping-Pong, Broken Thirds, Downbeat Lock, Pair Swap, Turnaround, Pedal). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
MENUExit MenuExits Menu Mode and returns to the sequencer.

Menu Mode: Voice Menu (MIDI Note Assignment)

Holding any VOICE pad for ≥ 200ms in Menu Mode (or holding a voice pad and tapping a step pad) enters Voice Menu Mode. The 4×4 step grid mirrors the 16-pad Ableton Drum Rack (notes 36–51, bottom row 36–39 to top row 48–51). The currently assigned pad for the active voice illuminates in white (COLOR_PPOS). Pads assigned to other voices illuminate in their respective voice colors. Available / unassigned pads are dark. Tap any step pad (1–16) to reassign or swap notes. Tap another voice pad to switch the voice being edited. Release the held voice pad to return to Menu Mode, or tap MENU to exit directly back to the sequencer.

Single-Voice Pattern Presets (FN1 + ACCENT + STEP n)

Applies preset n (1–16) to the active voice's current pattern. Patterns longer than 16 steps are printed page by page (16 steps per row). Velocity symbols: ■ Accent (127), ● Normal (99), ○ Ghost (50), · Rest.
